First of all nobody get this at all, there’s literally nothing at all, the mobile version is less complicated than the laptop, but theres not enough storage on phones to make a lot of videos without paying. reviews.title: Might Move to CapCut
reviews.text:
Been using Filmora for years and it WAS great for casual editing. However they keep locking more and more of the most basic features, like simply fading two videos together, behind the absurdly overpriced payed tier. Whats worse is they’ve recently deleted my ENTIRE EXTRACT AUDIO LIBRARY with no warning or anything.

They even went through a phase of purposely making video colours look worse after rendering to try and sell some payed HDR rendering fluff.

Also all the new AI rubbish has completely cluttered the app. Makes me feel sick every time I crack this sorry app open.

Would have given this app a solid 4 stars a few years ago, I’m being very generous with 2 as of right now.

reviews.title: AI employees
reviews.text: I need a good video editor, but this won’t be it. There is no pricing for available subscriptions that I see. So, i contacted Apple, and they advised to contact the developer. In other words, Apple wouldn’t help me with a. Price, but that’s ok, because it forced me to go to the Filmora website. I quickly found out that Filmora had done away with human customer service, and subscribed to AI. I have been listening to the warnings for a year now, about ai replacing people, and taking jobs, and I will have no part of it. Filmora is a company that wants you to invest in their products, when they are not investing in people anymore. I walked away from that. Do these companies think that replacing people will be that easy.  I wont use the product on principle. I wanted to talk to a human rep, but I couldn’t even communicate that much, as you have to select from options. I hate non sense like that. Want my business? Invest in people, say no to ai. Think about the people who have lost their jobs before subscribing. Jobs that used to pay the bills, now belong to expensive calculators. Filmora lost a new customer on principle. Maybe, they learn an appreciation for mankind, and begin hiring people again. Until then, there is no way i will support that business.

reviews.title: Are you🤬kidding me right now?
reviews.text:
Here’s a polished but still passionate version of your message:

Guys, you’ve got to be kidding me.

My subscription just renewed, and all I’m trying to do is a basic video edit with simple transitions. No AI. I use ElevenLabs for my voiceovers, and I use Filmora mainly for editing and background music. The only AI feature I really use is captions. I don’t need all the extra AI tools.

I’ve loved the simplicity and ease of Filmora for years. But after more than 15 years of using and supporting this software, I find myself seriously considering leaving because now I’m being pushed to upgrade to a premium plan just to access basic background music and transitions.

I don’t think so.

I’m genuinely disappointed. I understand that companies need to make money and that the economy is affecting everyone, but this feels excessive. Charging extra for features that many of us consider basic editing essentials is frustrating.

At this point, I may have to say goodbye to Wondershare Filmora. I never thought I’d be saying that. I considered going back to CapCut, but honestly, I’d rather move to DaVinci Resolve and invest my time in a platform that gives me the tools I need without constantly putting features behind another paywall.

Filmora has been a great program, but penny-pinching on music and transitions is where I draw the line. That’s just crazy.

I’m out.

reviews.title: Useful but terrible!
reviews.text:
This app is very helpful for small projects and even then it’s a headache. For someone that creates 1 to 2 minute video clips by animating photos using Filmora. It is a nightmare. Here are the issues: credits are needed to generate the images that have to be paid for however, when edits have to be made credits have to be used again
-the app is infamous for adding things that are not in the original image prompt forcing to have to re-edit it and use more credit
-the app is even slower now than it’s been over the past year. It used to take about a minute or less to animate one image now it takes about 1-5 minutes.
-the issue with this app is the constant regeneration of edits because the Apple ad words remove things and create weird movements that weren’t asked for no matter how simplistic or in depth the prompts are.
One is really at the mercy of the app, depending on the day and it could become costly. It seems the developer is content with these glitches, and for these reasons I can’t give this app more than one star

reviews.title: Crashes and says I don’t have a subscription when I do
reviews.text: This app didn’t have any issues when I first got it. I paid for a year in August 2025 and tonight when I logged in it’s telling me I don’t have a subscription (even though it shows being active in my Apple account) and I need to buy more “credits”. I paid for the year so I’m not really sure why I’d need to buy any credits. The app is also double what I paid for it a few months ago. The app crashes or freezes anytime I try to begin a project. I would invest in a more well known film editing app and don’t waste your money with this as it seems like either, there are a ton of bugs, or they just want you to keep paying for things even though you already have a subscription.

They keep failing and only after many rounds you can make it work yet you had to waste a lot of tokens. So stopped using it after a month and forgot about it. I cancelled the subscription immediately. However, this company make some brand renovation last year and somehow I got subscribed again, and only recently I found it out by email. I contacted the company to cancel the subscription and refund but they immediately refused. This is the worst AI video product ever and you know the Chinese are good at manipulating the ratings. So be aware of the scam and avoid it!

reviews.title: God help me bro
reviews.text: This is about my 12th bad review on an app like this, so at this point I’m simply copy/pasting my reviews because they all struggle with one problem that hits me way harder than anyone else. I am an amateur animator and I use apps just like this one to connect animation snippets into one whole video. Anyway, sometimes, I drag out frames because I need one exact frame to remain on the screen for a certain amount of time, usually around five seconds. But this app, just like every freaking other app I’ve tried, doesn’t keep it on there for freaking 5 seconds. But only for freaking ONE. Are you freaking serious? This amazing new hobby of mine I am getting so freaking frustrated over because someone freaking thought that cutting off dragged out scenes was a GOOD idea. News flash: it’s not! Most people with filmed content don’t struggle with this but me and my animating people do, so just freaking get this dumb mistake fixed so I can enter a freaking 13 second snippet of animation without it getting translated into freaking only six seconds. I know it’s a small thing but to me it’s everything. Please fix.
